summary: Lorebook entity is the field-meaning authority for CanonicalLorebook as CanonicalEntity lorebook LorebookBody, the superset for world info character book and memory formats baselined on RoleCall entry type. schema.ts owns types; this page owns meanings and producers. How to read the field tables repeats generated Field Type Producers Meaning rules from docs-fields. Composition is book settings plus flat LorebookEntry list and optional categories. Book settings covers identity globals budget and LorebookCategory folders. Entries is the large flat roughly 48-field entry with concern groups for identity triggers injection ordering recursion scan filters CharacterFilter side effects ST-lineage toggles NovelAI extensions EntryContextConfig LoreBiasPhrase LoreBiasGroup and metadata. What rides escrow, not a field lists RoleCall in-memory-only fields and wire twins. See also links architecture character character-book RoleCall NovelAI and formats matrix.

sections.title: How to read the field tables
sections.summary: Field tables are generated by scripts/docs-fields.ts and embedded verbatim; never hand-edit a cell, improve the schema doc comment and regenerate. Field is the canonical name with trailing question mark for optional. Type is the schema TypeScript type. Producers lists source formats from the doc comment or dash when untagged, including universal core content enabled triggers position depth. Meaning explains purpose; blank cells are self-evident primitives without schema annotation. Richer explanation lives only in surrounding prose never inside a cell.

sections.title: Composition
sections.summary: LorebookBody is book-level settings for identity categorization matching defaults and budget plus entries LorebookEntry array and optional categories LorebookCategory array for folders. Unlike CharacterBody the schema keeps LorebookEntry as one flat interface of roughly forty-eight fields matching RoleCall in-memory entry type without named sub-interfaces. This page groups fields by concern for readability while schema and generated table stay flat. Tables come from docs/generated/fields.lorebook.md.

sections.title: Book settings
sections.summary: Book settings hold identity categorization matching defaults and injection budget. name description lorebookType as open world character scenario rules utility other genre fandom and tags identify the book. enabled is RoleCall shelf and Press export filter default true deny by absence elsewhere. globalCaseSensitive globalMatchWholeWords globalScanDepth and globalRecursion are book-wide matching defaults entries inherit when null. tokenBudget budgetMode token or entry and entryBudget set the active cap. entries and categories complete the body. LorebookCategory child is id name sortOrder optional enabled folder grouping via entry categoryId.

children.title: LorebookCategory
children.summary: LorebookCategory is a folder grouping entries within a lorebook. Required id name and sortOrder with optional enabled. An entry joins one category via categoryId referencing this id. Organizational only, unrelated to activation groups.

sections.title: Entries
sections.summary: A LorebookEntry is one triggerable chunk with stable id referenced by categoryId and escrow twin matching. The full flat field table is followed by concern groups not separate types. Identity and content covers title comment content enabled constant. Triggers and matching plus Trigger shape gate activation with selectiveLogic and null inherit globals. Injection and placement sets position depth role. Ordering timing and grouping separates sortOrder placement priority eviction displayIndex list sticky cooldown delay groups probability. Recursion and budget covers exclude prevent delayUntil ignoreBudget useMemo. Scan sources extend match targets. Filters and side effects plus CharacterFilter EntrySideEffect EntrySideEffects are declarative never executed. ST-lineage toggles first-class vectorized group scoring automationId displayIndex. NovelAI extensions include keyRelative contextConfig and lore bias groups with EntryContextConfig LoreBiasPhrase LoreBiasGroup. Metadata is the open bag.

children.title: Identity and content
children.summary: title is the display name mapping to SillyTavern comment. comment is a separate RoleCall internal authoring note with no ST home so ST import always nulls it. content is the injected text itself. Together with the table fields enabled and constant they form the entry identity and payload core.

children.title: Triggers and matching
children.summary: triggers and secondaryTriggers are keyword or regex lists gating activation. selectiveLogic combines secondary with primary as and_any and_all not_any or not_all. triggerMode advanced when triggers carry per-trigger probability overriding entry fallback else simple. caseSensitive matchWholeWords and scanDepth are per-entry overrides of book globals where null inherits.

children.title: Trigger
children.summary: Trigger has required keyword and isRegex plus optional flags for regex g i m s u y, frequency as min messages before re-activation, and probability for advanced mode per-trigger chance 0-100 overriding entry fallback. Wire regex is slash pattern flags; canonical carries isRegex and flags structurally instead of a delimited string.

children.title: Injection and placement
children.summary: position chooses where content lands: world and character are the portable floor every format has as SillyTavern before after character definition; richer positions degrade to that floor on downcast to CCv2 character_book. depth applies when position is depth or append. role is system user or assistant for the injected message voice.

children.title: Ordering, timing, and grouping
children.summary: sortOrder is placement order in the assembled prompt the universal axis every format names differently. priority is eviction priority when budget is exceeded higher survives a separate axis. displayIndex is a third list-order axis detailed under ST-lineage. sticky cooldown and delay are turn-counted timing. groupName with groupWeight is activation mutual exclusion; categoryId is organizational only. probability is entry-level activation chance fallback for simple triggers.

children.title: Recursion and budget
children.summary: excludeRecursion keeps the entry from being found by recursive scan of other entries so only direct matches apply. preventRecursion stops this entry content from triggering others. delayUntilRecursion activates only at recursion level N with zero as first pass. ignoreBudget always injects bypassing token budget. useMemo marks client-specific memo behavior.

children.title: Scan sources
children.summary: scanCharacterDescription scanCharacterPersonality scanUserPersona and scanScenario extend keyword matching beyond chat to those character and user texts. scanCharacterDepthPrompt and scanCreatorNotes are SillyTavern-only extras where undefined means the format has no field not that scanning is off. scanCreatorNotes lacks its own producer tag because the schema comment covers both ST sources together; the SillyTavern lorebook codec confirms matchCreatorNotes round-trips like its sibling.

children.title: Filters and side effects
children.summary: characterFilter whitelists or blacklists the entry to specific characters or character tags. sideEffects lists variable mutations to run when the entry activates. Both are declarative data shapes; Hoplight never executes them. Detailed field shapes follow in CharacterFilter EntrySideEffect and EntrySideEffects children.

children.title: CharacterFilter
children.summary: CharacterFilter has names and tags string arrays plus isExclude boolean to whitelist or blacklist which characters an entry may activate for, matching by character name or tag membership.

children.title: EntrySideEffect
children.summary: EntrySideEffect is one variable mutation row: type among setvar addvar incvar decvar delvar, variable name, optional value for setvar, optional amount for addvar incvar decvar, and scope local or global. Declarative data only; converter and editor never execute.

children.title: EntrySideEffects
children.summary: EntrySideEffects wraps effects as EntrySideEffect array plus onlyOnFirstTrigger and clearOnDeactivate booleans controlling when mutations apply relative to activation lifecycle. Still declarative never executed by Hoplight.

children.title: ST-lineage toggles
children.summary: vectorized groupOverride useGroupScoring automationId and displayIndex are authored SillyTavern-lineage fields first-classed under schema-is-editor even though only ST serializes them today. vectorized is the RAG setting not the vectors which stay escrow. groupOverride and useGroupScoring extend groupName groupWeight mutual exclusion. automationId binds Quick-Reply automation by id only automation set stays escrow. displayIndex is creator manual list order distinct from sortOrder; real cards diverge so it is never regenerated from sortOrder.

children.title: NovelAI extensions
children.summary: keyRelative makes keys match relative to the entry insertion point not story tail. nonStoryActivatable allows activation outside story text such as UI actions. contextConfig is NovelAI per-entry assembly prefix suffix trim and budget dials detailed in EntryContextConfig. loreBiasGroups carries NovelAI phrase bias groups applied while the entry is active or whenInactive not active.

children.title: EntryContextConfig
children.summary: EntryContextConfig is NovelAI authored per-entry assembly: prefix and suffix text, tokenBudget and reservedTokens, trimDirection doNotTrim trimBottom trimTop open, insertionType newline space token, maximumTrimType sentence newline token, and insertionPosition as signed offset within the target section not canonical depth. NAI budgetPriority is deliberately not modeled here because placement lives in sortOrder one home per axis.

children.title: LoreBiasPhrase
children.summary: LoreBiasPhrase holds optional sequence string sequences string array and type as NovelAI phrase type integer open enum on the wire for members of a lore bias group.

children.title: LoreBiasGroup
children.summary: LoreBiasGroup is a NovelAI phrase bias group with enabled boolean, signed bias strength, phrases as LoreBiasPhrase array, and optional whenInactive generateOnce and ensureSequenceFinish controls for when and how the bias applies relative to entry activity.

children.title: Metadata
children.summary: metadata is an open Record string unknown bag for format-specific data that has no first-class canonical home on the entry, extensible without inventing body slots.

sections.title: What rides escrow, not a field
sections.summary: Per the superset rule a field needs a real wire serializer. Rides escrow because no serializer emits them: five RoleCall in-memory-only fields allowRecursion boostIds boostAmount scanPreset and probabilityMode verified absent from packages/lorebook serialize and parser with hard-coded defaults and corroborated by this repo RoleCall lorebook codec never naming them. Format-specific wire bytes also ride raw twin for lossless same-format round trip: SillyTavern entry uid derives canonical id then re-emits from twin, RoleCall export envelope tree exportDate unsupportedFields and trigger runtime state. Does NOT ride escrow: ST extra scan sources vectorized groupOverride useGroupScoring automationId and displayIndex which are authored wire fields first-classed by schema-is-editor.

sections.summary: Related authority: architecture for canonical model escrow hub-and-spoke and adapter contract; character for knowledgeRefs linking; character-book concept for embedded character_book extract and re-embed; rolecall format as baseline of the canonical entry shape; novelai format as source of contextConfig loreBiasGroups keyRelative nonStoryActivatable; formats README for the producer coverage matrix.
